svg.text: Pilot on one VM (blue-green), growth on two VMs behind a load balancer, scale on managed containers. Same Docker image at every stage.
Move to the next stage when: CPU is above 60% for a week, you need zero-downtime deploys, or a third service exists. The Docker image never changes; only where it runs.
Part 10 · System diagrams · Mulungushi University, Zambia
